verdict.rationale: Raygun documents 'smart filters' that segment errors by date, location, version, host, OS, browser and custom tags, and the changelog mentions a search results page. That covers filtering by tag and release/version, but there is no evidence of a real query language, cross-project search, or filtering by environment or arbitrary custom properties. Missing for 10: documented query syntax, cross-project/cross-application search, explicit environment and custom-property filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.
